exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.how: 3 sets of as many as you can with good form; rest 60s.

exercises.name: Pike push-ups
exercises.how: 3 sets of 8-12. Hips high, lower your head toward the floor.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.how: 3 sets of 8-12.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shoulder press
exercises.how: 3 sets of 8-12, seated or standing.

exercises.name: Barbell bench press
exercises.how: 4 sets of 5-8. Use a spotter or safety bars.

exercises.name: Overhead press
exercises.how: 3 sets of 5-8.

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.how: 3 sets of 6-12 on parallel bars or a sturdy chair.

exercises.name: Chin-ups
exercises.how: 3 sets of as many as you can; use a band if needed.

exercises.name: Inverted rows
exercises.how: 3 sets of 8-15 under a sturdy table or bar.

exercises.name: Dumbbell rows
exercises.how: 3 sets of 10 each arm.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curls
exercises.how: 3 sets of 10-15.

exercises.name: Barbell rows
exercises.how: 4 sets of 6-10.

exercises.name: Deadlifts
exercises.how: 3 sets of 5. Keep your back flat.

exercises.name: Superman holds
exercises.how: 3 holds of 30 seconds.

exercises.name: Squats
exercises.how: 3 sets of 15-20 bodyweight squats.

exercises.name: Lunges
exercises.how: 3 sets of 10 each leg.

exercises.name: Goblet squats
exercises.how: 3 sets of 10-15 holding one dumbbell.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlifts
exercises.how: 3 sets of 10. Hinge at the hips.

exercises.name: Back squats
exercises.how: 4 sets of 5-8.

exercises.name: Glute bridges
exercises.how: 3 sets of 15.

exercises.name: Calf raises
exercises.how: 3 sets of 20.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.how: 3 holds of 30-60 seconds (core).

exercises.name: Pull-ups
exercises.how: 3 sets of as many as you can; use a band or a jump to help if needed.

exercises.name: Hanging knee raises
exercises.how: 3 sets of 10; lift the knees slowly, no swinging.

exercises.name: Band pull-aparts
exercises.how: 3 sets of 15; squeeze the shoulder blades together.

exercises.name: Band rows
exercises.how: Anchor the band; 3 sets of 15, elbows close to your sides.

exercises.name: Band chest press
exercises.how: Band behind your back; 3 sets of 12 pushes forward.

exercises.name: Band squats
exercises.how: Stand on the band, handles at shoulders; 3 sets of 15.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swings
exercises.how: 5 sets of 15; drive with the hips, arms just guide it.

exercises.name: Kettlebell press
exercises.how: 3 sets of 8 each arm; brace your stomach.

exercises.name: Kettlebell rows
exercises.how: 3 sets of 10 each arm; back flat.

exercises.name: Bench dips
exercises.how: 3 sets of 10-15; shoulders down, elbows back.

exercises.name: Step-ups
exercises.how: 3 sets of 10 each leg; push through the front heel.

exercises.name: Chest press machine
exercises.how: 3 sets of 10-12; control the way back.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.how: 3 sets of 10-12; pull to the top of your chest.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.how: 3 sets of 12; chest up, pull to your stomach.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.how: 3 sets of 10-12; don't lock your knees at the top.
